money.proofkit_order_definition: BPJ membership orders first attributed to the customer quote studio; states are not export counts or profit. Other membership tools and older orders excluded; failed query is null.

proofkit_orders_complete_utc.definition: First-source ProofKit membership orders created in the stated UTC window, with payment and expiry classified at the window end. Each order counts once. Package generation and profit require separate records.

money.video_order_definition: Orders first created from the video membership entry within this window; paid means confirmed payment, not profit or causal attribution.
money.proposal_deck_order_definition: Membership orders first attributed to ProposalDeck and created during this complete UTC window, classified at its exclusive end. Paid means a confirmed payment recorded by then. Each order is counted once. Buyer, cloud delivery and profit metrics require separate records. A failed read is null.

trade_workbench_orders_complete_utc.definition: Membership orders first attributed to the trade workbench and created in this complete UTC window, classified at its exclusive end. Paid means a confirmed payment recorded by then. Orders count once. A failed read is null.

money.scope_note: Inventory/state counts are lifetime unless a metric explicitly says window; go_28d and biz_28d retain legacy names and use the requested window. Video-order states are windowed. These are not an attributed acquisition funnel.
